questions.stem: One article is deliberately created to make people believe something false; another wrong report is shared without any intent to harm. Which option explains the difference?
options: Disinformation involves intentional deception, while fake news may be false without deliberate intent to harm
Fake news spreads only on social media
Both terms mean exactly the same

questions.stem: A website collects personal details from children. What does a children's online privacy law specifically control?
options: Every type of cyber attack on all users
The online collection of personal information from children under 13
Security standards for all business networks

questions.stem: A user finds that unknown software is secretly monitoring activity and collecting personal information without permission. Which malware is responsible?
options: A virus that attaches itself to programs
Ransomware that locks data for payment
A Trojan horse disguised as a useful program

questions.stem: A student sees that a website's address begins with HTTPS instead of HTTP. What does this mainly indicate?
options: The site is faster than every HTTP site
Communication with the site is protected by encryption
The site has no adverts or harmful content

questions.stem: A Canadian company collects and uses customers' personal information. Which law sets the rules for protecting this information in the private sector?
options: A cybersecurity law covering all internet crime
The Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA)
A computer crimes act about illegal access

questions.stem: What security feature does HTTPS provide?
options: Encryption of communication between user and server

questions.stem: A user types the correct address of a banking website but is secretly redirected to a fake site. Which attack is this?
options: Phishing, using fake messages to steal information
Pharming, redirecting users to fraudulent websites

questions.stem: A user cannot use online resources because their area lacks internet facilities and technology. This situation represents the:
A company invents a new device and wants the legal right to stop others making or selling it for a limited time. Which protection should it apply for?
What is the main function of cookies on websites?
options: To store small text files about a user's interactions with the site

questions.stem: A user is creating a password for an online account. Which practice is most secure?
options: Only small letters, to remember it easily
Personal details such as name and birth date
A mix of uppercase and lowercase letters, numbers and symbols

questions.stem: A government law allows authorities to monitor communication channels under specific conditions and controls access to communication records. Which area does it mainly address?
options: Interception of telecommunications and access to communication data

questions.stem: A company wants to improve system security while protecting user privacy. Which statement best explains the relationship?
options: Stronger privacy protection can need controls that affect convenience and usability
Privacy removes the need for security

questions.stem: One program can be used free forever; another can be used free only for a limited trial. What is the difference?
options: Freeware is free permanently, while shareware is usually a limited trial

questions.stem: A new computing innovation improves communication, automates tasks and increases efficiency. Which is NOT one of its benefits?
A student searches websites, posts comments and uploads pictures. The trail of information these activities create is the:
Which practice shows responsible software use?
options: Using illegally modified software to avoid payment
Sharing one licensed copy with unlimited users
Following software licences and respecting copyright
Turning off security software to speed up

questions.stem: A school network administrator wants to protect computers by monitoring and controlling network connections. Which tool should be used?
options: Antivirus that only removes infected files
A firewall that controls incoming and outgoing traffic

questions.stem: Aisha gets an email that looks like it is from her bank, asking her to click a link and verify her account; the sender's address is slightly different from the bank's. What threat is this?
A company develops new software and automatically holds the right to control how it is copied and distributed. Which protection applies?
Ali posts his address, phone number and daily schedule on social media and uses the same password for every account. Which safety practice is he violating?
options: He overshares personal information and uses weak password practices
He should post more to be safe

questions.stem: A person gains unauthorized access to a company's database and steals customers' credit card details. What is this called?
Fatima copies her important files to an external drive and cloud storage in case her laptop is stolen or damaged. Which security measure is this?
A site shows "Your connection is not secure" beside the URL just as users are about to enter card details. What should they do?
options: Continue, it is probably a mistake
Avoid entering sensitive information and leave the site

questions.stem: Ahmed's antivirus warns that a file from an untrusted site contains a virus, but he opens it anyway. What is the most likely result?
options: His computer may be infected with malware

questions.stem: A rural school has limited internet, while a city school has fast connections and the latest computers, so rural students cannot use online resources well. This illustrates the:
Zara uses a coffee shop's public Wi-Fi for online banking and sees suspicious account activity the next day. What was the risk?
options: Sensitive transactions over public Wi-Fi can be intercepted by hackers
Coffee shop Wi-Fi is always secure
Banking must be done on desktops only

questions.stem: A completely false story that a celebrity has died spreads quickly online; its creator made it to get more views and traffic. This is an example of:
Hassan finds paid software offered free on an unofficial website and wants to download it to save money. What should he consider?
options: Free downloads from unofficial sources often contain malware

questions.stem: Sarah posted a holiday photo showing her house number and street while she was away, and her home was broken into a week later. What could have prevented this?
options: Privacy settings and not sharing location details publicly
